name: Local AI Tooling
description: Installs Aider, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Claude Code, and connects them to a shared Ollama instance running on the host machine.

model.description: Ollama model to use as the default for Aider, Codex, and Continue.dev. Choose based on available RAM: 7b (~8GB), 14b (~16GB), 32b (~20GB). Examples: qwen2.5-coder:14b, codestral:22b, deepseek-coder-v2:16b. Set to 'none' to skip Ollama setup entirely (tools are still installed).
